items.name: Captain's Cove competition 2007
items.information:
The competition will be outside on a sort of boardwalk, but will be covered with a large tent. In case of bad weather, there 
will be room available inside.
The entrance fee is $5, and the total money collected will be donated to Swim Across the Sound.

items.name: Italian Open 2007
items.information: Registration is open to any persons of any age of any country.

items.name: San Diego competition 2007
items.information:
The price of the competition is $5 for preregistered and $10 for not preregistered.
Preregistration ends May 19. Send an e-mail to [Adam Zamora](mailto:mistizo858@hotmail.com) for preregistration.
On-site registration will be from 9:00 till 10:00 and competition starts at 10am.
